title: Termination at the final position
statement: For every bit string $x$ and register assignment $v$ with $v(r)\le 4(|x|+1)$ for every register $r$, the fixed multiplication program, started in its final-position state with registers $v$ and no answer recorded, halts with Boolean answer true exactly when $v(12)=v(1)$ and $v(11)=0$. Every configuration before halting satisfies the program's instruction side conditions and the same register bound.
